untestable.reason: Server-only: the server must answer a non-JSON or type-less frame with bad_frame. A conforming client never sends one, so the client cannot show it. The client-side handling of junk frames is tested under C-21.
Server-only: the client checks the name before connecting (C-5) and always sends protocol 1, so it never sends a hello with a bad name or protocol.
Server-only: the client checks to and body with the same rules first (C-11), so the server never sees an invalid send. How the client handles a server error that carries an id is tested under C-17.
Server-only: the client refuses to send to itself (C-11), so a self-addressed send never reaches the server.
Server-only and silent: if the server ignores a delivered for an unknown id, nothing happens that the client could show.
Server-only: a conforming client can never send a message to itself (C-11), so the server never has one to wrongly deliver to the sender.
